basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Entrepreneur & AI Product Builder | 3× Founder | MBA | Startup Mentor & Speaker
basics.summary: Operator who turns ideas into shipped, revenue-generating products. Founded 3 companies on the side (SwissNRI, Proplab, PulseView) and run Anand Creations, a studio for AI-native products taken from concept to real customers solo. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps reporting directly to C-level, and Startup Mentor at Tenity where I evaluate 20+ startups per year for seed-to-VC decisions. MBA (93.2%), 4 international conference talks, hired and mentored engineers who now lead independently. 13+ years across engineering, product, GTM, hiring, and partnerships (Unilever, CES). High bias to action, high ownership, comfortable with no structure.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Own AI product transformation end to end, reporting directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress. Multi-agent outbound system shipped to production: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $1M in quarterly revenue.
Lead technical discovery through production. Cross-functional with Sales, Product, and Ops on rollout, evals, and adoption. Set the AI standards the rest of the org now follows.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Member of the Technology Evaluation Panel. Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading; advised multiple portfolio companies on hiring, AI strategy, and building engineering cultures that ship.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end to end and ran the GTM with Sales and PM. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR.
Co-owned cross-functional GTM launches (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Every launch shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle.
Acting hiring manager for AI roles. Hired for craft and curiosity; grew engineers who now lead features independently. Built and mentored the AI engineering cohort.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks. Concept to production, no external gatekeepers.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery startup. Built product, cloud stack, and operator UI from an empty repo to 500+ real-world autonomous deliveries.
Built external partnerships with Unilever and secured a CES Las Vegas showcase. Turned prototypes into customer-facing narratives that closed the next opportunity.

work.name: Obermatt
highlights: Bridged business and engineering to deliver scalable finance products. Built strategic roadmaps that lifted customer satisfaction and retention.
Directed a remote engineering team; introduced agile practices (productivity up 20%) and CI/CD with Docker (deployment times down 30%).
